node.title: Re: Use an incrementing counter as a variable
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
It's theoretically possible, but [https://perl.plover.com/varvarname.html|"it's stupid to use a variable as a variable name"].

Usually, a hash serves well in these situations:

use warnings; use strict; my $counter = 0; my %hash; while (<>) { $counter++; $hash{"bin_$counter"} = $_; # or whatever } use Data::Dumper; print Dumper(\%hash);
